ratings.note: Van/trailer subset with missing or mistyped permit (f1); probes show the error only after Book, on a page with no permit field (i2); recurs each such booking (p1).
Residents whose plans change (f1); only route is a weekday phone call, a support contact (i3); structural (p2). s=4; rated 3 because the slot can simply go unused and no data or money is lost.
Same-day bookings picking early slots (f1); three steps of entry wasted before refusal (i2); each occurrence (p1).
Van/trailer users only (f1); permit requirement not discoverable at the field, so they hit it late (i2); learned once (p0).
Anyone pausing in the declared multitasking context, slower AT users (f2); slot lost after full entry with no warning (i2); each slow booking (p1).
Unannounced 5-minute limit across three steps including personal details (f2); scarce slot lost at the last step (i2); each booking (p1).
Every car booking sees the field (f3); hesitation, field can be left empty (i1); learned after one booking (p0).
Shown to every resident before choosing a vehicle (f3); hesitation only (i1); learned once (p0).
Van/trailer users who open the help (f1); must search the council site, no timing info (i1); each such booking (p1).
Only on an expired hold (f1); pressing Book again just re-errors and Change slot is present (i1); learned (p0).
Keyboard/SR users after a failed Next (f1); extra navigation to reach the control (i1); each occurrence (p1).
Cancelled bookings are rare (f0); SR users hear 'Booked' first and may misread the status (i2); every view (p1).
Every booking (f3); 1.5 s with no visible feedback invites a second tap (i1); each booking (p1).
Every car booking (f3); hesitation, not a blocker (i1); learned after one booking (p0).
Forced-colours users only (f0); selected day hard to see (i1); persistent (p2). s=2; rated 1 because the chosen date is restated in text directly under Slots.
Only at 320 px / high zoom (f0); 320 capture shows the grid wider than card and rule, i.e. horizontal overflow (i1); persistent at that width (p2).
Residents changing plans (f1); must phone in weekday hours, a support contact (i3); structural (p2). s=4; rated 3, the slot is left unused rather than data or money lost.
Every booking (f3); page kept for the gate lacks day and 20-minute window, risking wrong-time arrival (i2); every reopen (p2). s=4; rated 3 because confirm showed it and an SMS reminder is sent.
Every use of Change slot / Back (f2); day silently resets to Today so a wrong day can be booked (i2); every change (p1).
Pausing residents (f2); slot lost without warning (i2); each booking (p1).
Cancelled views are rare (f0); H1 'Booked' plus show-at-gate text can send a resident on a wasted trip to be turned away (i3); each view (p1).
Double taps on phones, encouraged by the missing pending state (f1); booking silently cancelled under a 'Booked' heading, turned away at the gate (i3); each booking (p1).
Lapsed holds (f1); recovery via Change slot not signposted, lost slot not shown (i1); each expiry (p1).
Every booking (f3); day, window and vehicle missing from the gate artefact (i2); every reopen (p2). s=4; rated 3, confirm showed them and an SMS reminder exists.
Every day choice (f3); brief empty area and a lost Next tap (i1); learned after the first wait (p0).
Every day view (f3); Morning list misses early slots (i1); p1. s=3; rated 2 because the screenshot shows the Few-left row first and prominent, so the slots are not hidden.
Post-submit rejections (f1); must find Change vehicle/slot unaided (i1); each occurrence (p1).
Every booking (f3); memory load only, slot shown again on confirm (i1); p1. s=3; rated 2 because the harm is small unless interrupted.
